provenance: Labels re-audited 2026-08-28. The original 2026-08-25 labels were the frozen 2026-08 opus judge's own decisions; two independent modern judges (claude-opus-5 current, claude-fable-5 max) each agreed with only 29/40 and with each other on 36/40, so the frozen judge was the outlier. The set now committed contains: 6 frozen labels flipped where both modern judges agreed, every one of them matched -> unmatched; 3 consensus flips declined on full-context adjudication, which is every unmatched -> matched flip the modern consensus proposed — all three were same-file false positives (3827655676, a claim about the backfill parser rejecting a multi-paragraph handoff note against a defect about a broken code span and list indentation at the same doc lines; 3827655684, a claim about the missing Branch: line, which is defect 3827636772, against a defect about the trailing-blank-line rejection in isBoundedCloudHandoff; 3830695396, a claim about the AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK_HELD guard and the poisoned success stamp against a defect about 'is set' vs 'is non-empty' wording at :1157). Both blind modern judges therefore share a systematic over-matching bias on file overlap, and a future audit must adjudicate proposed unmatched -> matched flips on full context rather than trust their agreement. The set also holds 2 modern-contested pairs adjudicated matched (3829659550, same fails-open-on-null-head defect in the same function; 3829986403, the claim names duplicate-dispatch acceptance and the exactly-one fix) and 6 records replaced to restore balance. The 6 dropped records were the two pairs whose stored content was too degraded to judge (3830003055-matched, whose excerpt truncated out the matching partition item at set construction, and 3830371325-matched, whose stored defect detail is CodeRabbit analysis-script noise) plus the four least informative consensus-unmatched records (3830371325-unmatched, same noise detail; 3829659546-unmatched, whose detail truncates before the requirement it states; and 3829986398-unmatched and 3830003055-unmatched, which repeat one identical truncated hazard-table excerpt from the same cell and never name the defect's file). Their six replacements are matched pairs taken from the 2026-08-28 scored run and re-confirmed on the merits here: 3830366234, 3830366247, 3830416461, 3828328194, 3830366547 and 3830366556.
method: For every bench2 run cell (runs/<pr>/<condition>/), the structural pre-filter of match_findings.py was replayed over the stored review output to rebuild the numbered candidate list. Each numbered entry in the cell's judge_reasoning maps to one candidate defect; the label is matched when that defect id appears in the cell's matched_ids, unmatched otherwise. claim_excerpt is the passage of the review that names the defect's file, taken verbatim. Cells whose reasoning keys did not cover 1..N were skipped. The sample was built balanced 20 matched / 20 unmatched; the 2026-08-28 re-audit and rebalance moved it to 18 matched / 22 unmatched, spread across 6 contract PRs and 22 run conditions (see provenance and counts for the current numbers). The six records added in the rebalance come from the 2026-08-28 scored run detail directory instead, where candidate_index indexes that cell's claims[] array.

When a developer exports GATE_TEST_FOCUS and invokes the documented agent-quality-gate.sh --run --no-lock mode (or sets AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK=0), this guard allows the focused subset to answer for the full gate. acquire_gate_run_lock returns immediately for that mode at scripts/agent-quality-

records.claim_excerpt:
- [P2] Refuse focused tests in lockless gate runs — /private/tmp/fx-1995/scripts/agent-quality-gate.test.sh:600-603
  When a developer uses the documented `--no-lock` or `AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK=0` escape hatch while `GATE_TEST_FOCUS` is exported, lock acquisition returns without setting `AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK_HELD`, so this guard does not fire. The gate's mapped self-test can then run only the selected family and report success without the full suite, contrary to the contract in `docs/notes/agent-quality-gate-mechanics.md:1139-1146`. Detect gate execution independently of lock ownership, or clear the focus before mapped commands.

records.claim_excerpt:
- **The fix already exists in the gate.** `AGENTQG_RUN` is exported into every mapped command by `run_with_timeout` (`agent-quality-gate.sh:5085`), the single execution path for both the serial (`:5356`) and parallel (`:5403`) branches, and it is set for no-lock runs too (`agentqg:nolock-$$`, `:620-622`). Guard on `AGENTQG_RUN` instead of `AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK_HELD`; no new marker needed. Note the lock family clears `AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK_HELD` deliberately in `run_locked_gate` (`:5966-5967`) — it does not clear `AGENTQG_RUN`, so check whether those nested fixture runs need the same treatment for the new variable.
- **The shrunken run poisons the next push.** A green `--run` writes the whole-run success stamp unconditionally of lock mode (`agent-quality-gate.sh:5868-5877`); the pre-push hook is `--run --parallel 3 --skip-if-fresh --base origin/main` (`.trunk/trunk.yaml:136`) and exits on that stamp (`:4843-4848`). And `--no-lock` is exactly what the gate's own lock-timeout message tells a developer to use (`:1811`). So the escape-hatch path is the likely one, and its result is cached into the push that follows. (Per-command stamps are not a vector — the self-test is stamp-exempt, `:5224`.)
- Same false claim in prose: `docs/notes/agent-quality-gate-mechanics.md:1143-1146` says the focus is refused when `AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK_HELD` is set, "any command a real gate run spawns". Fix with the code.

records.claim_excerpt:
- Why it matters: The new tests assert malformed stETH fields keep revenue partial. That holds for malformed strings, but a malformed non-string value can crash the revenue build instead of producing the partial state.
- Evidence: [daily-series.ts](/private/tmp/fx-2001/ui-dashboard/src/lib/canonical-revenue/daily-series.ts:66) calls `value.trim()` before the `try`. `useReserveYieldHistory` returns raw GraphQL rows as typed data without a row schema parser at [use-reserve-yield-history.ts](/private/tmp/fx-2001/ui-dashboard/src/hooks/use-reserve-yield-history.ts:149). A `null` or numeric amount field would throw `TypeError`.
- Suggested fix: Change `isZeroWei` to accept `unknown`, return `false` unless `typeof value === "string"`, then trim and parse. Add a regression test with `balanceAmount: null as unknown as string`.
- Confidence: Medium. The GraphQL schema should normally return strings, but this path has no runtime guard.
